summary: Install-time system and environment beacon in @apexfdn/apex
details: install.cjs runs at npm install time and uses the Node os and https modules together with reads of process.env and process.platform to assemble host/environment information and send it out over HTTPS. The script executes automatically as an install lifecycle hook, so simply running `npm install @apexfdn/apex` triggers the outbound beacon carrying installer host identifiers and environment data. The package does not present a documented purpose that would require collecting environment variables and host metadata at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
